content: TypeScript 7.0 (Corsa, the Go-native port) went GA 2026-07-08 and is now the 'latest' dist-tag on npm (confirmed 7.0.2 via npm view). It intentionally preserves 6.x type-checking semantics but hard-breaks tooling that imports the typescript npm package's JS compiler API programmatically (ts-node, ts-morph, typescript-eslint, ts-jest, typedoc, api-extractor, vue-tsc/Volar) because TS7 does not ship a programmatic API yet (expected 7.1). tsconfig defaults also changed: rootDir now defaults to '.', baseUrl is no longer a universal alias mechanism, types defaults to [] (no @types auto-discovery), and target:es5/moduleResolution:node10/classic are removed. This is a live risk for a fresh monorepo tsconfig bootstrap: pinning to latest TypeScript now means typescript-eslint (near-certain future addition) will not work until 7.1 ships the compiler API back.
